title: PV Sindhu: "I'm not young anymore, but 31 is the new 21"

title: PV Sindhu Qualifies for BWF World Tour Finals, First Appearance in Five Years

summary: Indian shuttler PV Sindhu has qualified for the BWF World Tour Finals in Hangzhou, making her first appearance at the season-ending event since 2021.

title: Badminton Fund Row: SAI, BAI Tussle Left Players to Fend for Themselves
indian_angle: An administrative dispute between SAI and BAI reportedly caused top Indian players like PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen to cover their own expenses due to delayed fund clearances.
summary: A dispute between the Sports Authority of India (SAI) and the Badminton Association of India (BAI) led to delays in fund disbursement, forcing players like PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen to pay for their participation.
